intents.name: greeting
intents.description: The user is greeting the chatbot or starting a conversation.

intents.name: order_tracking
intents.description: The user wants to track the current location or progress of an order.

intents.name: order_status
intents.description: The user asks about the current status of an order.

intents.name: order_cancellation
intents.description: The user wants to cancel an order.

intents.name: delivery_delay
intents.description: The user reports that a delivery is delayed or late.

intents.name: return_request
intents.description: The user wants to return a purchased product.

intents.name: refund_status
intents.description: The user asks about the status of a refund.

intents.name: payment_failed
intents.description: The user reports that a payment failed or was declined.

intents.name: payment_issue
intents.description: The user has a general problem with a payment, charge, or billing.

intents.name: product_information
intents.description: The user asks for product details, availability, specifications, or pricing.

intents.name: account_login
intents.description: The user is having trouble logging into their account.

intents.name: password_reset
intents.description: The user needs help resetting or recovering their password.

intents.name: damaged_product
intents.description: The user received a damaged, broken, or defective product.

intents.name: complaint
intents.description: The user wants to make a complaint or reports dissatisfaction.

intents.name: human_agent
intents.description: The user wants to speak with a human customer-support agent.

intents.name: goodbye
intents.description: The user is ending the conversation.

intents.name: unknown
intents.description: The user message does not match any supported customer-service intent.
